# FormatToTaskWait

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Unpacks the registers of a WaitOn() on a task.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
TaskWaitResult FormatToTaskWait(SvcResult r);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Result of WaitOn() on a task handle. |

## Returns

The status, the outcome (TASK_EXITED or TASK_FAULTED) and the exit status or fault reason.
